# activedirectory_computers (Data Source)

Search for computers under a container by scope and filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Search for computers under a container by scope and filter. filter_by
# terms are escaped for you and ANDed together; a raw ldap_filter is ANDed
# on top, so you own its correctness.
data "activedirectory_computers" "servers" {
  container   = "OU=Servers,DC=corp,DC=local"
  scope       = "subtree"
  ldap_filter = "(operatingSystem=*Server*)"
}

output "server_hostnames" {
  value = [for c in data.activedirectory_computers.servers.computers : c.dns_hostname]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `container` (String) SearchBase DN. Defaults to the domain root.
- `filter_by` (Map of String) Attribute equality terms, ANDed. Values are escaped for you.
- `ldap_filter` (String) Raw LDAP filter, ANDed with filter_by. You own its correctness.
- `max_results` (Number) Cap on results (default 1000). Exceeding it is an error, not truncation.
- `scope` (String) base, one_level, or subtree (default).

### Read-Only

- `computers` (Attributes List) Matching computers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--computers))

<a id="nestedatt--computers"></a>

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.

- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `kerberos_encryption_type` (Set of String) The Kerberos encryption types the account supports.
